note: Synthetic credentials for the Phase-12 shadow-parity dataset. These are FIXTURE VALUES, published in the repository on purpose and documented here so nobody has to guess them. They are not credentials for anything: the rows they unlock live only in two disposable databases that this gate creates and drops, and they are a bcrypt hash of a string printed in this file.
whyTheseEmails: The `.invalid` TLD is reserved by RFC 2606 precisely so a fixture can never resolve or be delivered to. No message this harness sends can leave the host.
neverUsedFor: any account outside the disposable shadow databases
any environment in which the harness was not given -CompareOnly against its own databases
